title: Data Architect
description:
Reed Technology is delighted to be supporting a leading public sector organisation in the search for an experienced Data Architect to lead the development of its enterprise data architecture capability.

This is a unique opportunity for a hands-on data professional who enjoys shaping strategy while remaining close to the technology. The organisation is at a pivotal stage in its data journey, offering the chance to establish a Data Architecture practice from the ground up and influence how data is managed, governed and leveraged across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess the organisation's current data landscape, identifying gaps, challenges and opportunities within a fragmented environment.
  • Develop a clear and scalable data architecture roadmap aligned to organisational priorities and future business needs.
  • Create and maintain enterprise, domain, conceptual, logical and physical data models to provide a consistent and shared view of data across the organisation.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand data requirements, map data flows and design effective data solutions.
  • Define data architecture standards, principles and best practices to promote consistency, quality and reuse.
  • Design approaches that improve data interoperability, integration and governance across multiple systems and services.
  • Support the adoption of modern data technologies and contribute to the organisation's long-term data strategy.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers, Analysts and technical teams, providing hands-on guidance and technical leadership where required.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in a Data Architect or similar position, defining, implementing and evolving enterprise data architecture frameworks.
  • Extensive experience designing data models from scratch across complex environments.
  • Strong knowledge of the Microsoft data ecosystem, including Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Hands-on technical capability, with experience building data pipelines, developing proof-of-concepts and working closely with engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of metadata management, data governance and emerging AI-driven data capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience operating within complex or highly regulated environments would be advantageous.

What's on Offer?

  • Permanent position
  • £70,000 - £83,500 / annum (DOE)
  • Excellent pension scheme
  • 35-hour working week, Monday to Friday (hybrid)
  • Flexible working hours with an attractive flexi-time scheme
  • Supportive and collaborative working environment
  • Rare opportunity to build and establish a Data Architecture function, influencing strategy, governance and technology from the ground up
